sync: diagnostic log when no IBD candidate among connected peers
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/12

Observability followup to #11 (now merged as v1.11.1). When `should_ibd` returns `None` despite live P2P — i.e. the supervisor is silently wedged from the outside — emit a per-peer eligibility breakdown every 5 minutes so the wedge state is triagable from logs alone.

## Why

`should_ibd` is a 3-way AND (`tip.confirmed || ever_confirmed_for_ibd`, `cooldown_ok`, `is_better_chain`). When it returns `None` and stays that way, the supervisor idles indefinitely — no "Sync manager: starting IBD" line, no warning, RPC still responsive. Every wedge of this shape I've debugged needed source-walking the selection logic to identify which clause was failing. This log surfaces each peer's row through the decision tree directly.

## What

```
Sync manager: no IBD candidate among 8 connected peer(s) — eligibility breakdown:
  [a,b,c,d] ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok    tip_h=628000 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [e,f,g,h] ever_ibd=true  cooldown=ok    tip=none
  [i,j,k,l] ever_ibd=false cooldown=23s   tip_h=627800 conf=false cw_gt=true
```

Throttle: 5-min period, reset whenever the supervisor re-enters IBD so the next wedge emits immediately instead of waiting out the window.

## Live evidence (fly.io, v1.11.1 base)

Deployed on `exfer-node-stack` after #11 merged. The diagnostic fired within minutes of the supervisor entering a wedge:

```
Sync manager: no IBD candidate among 8 connected peer(s) — eligibility breakdown:
  [179, 87, 63, 251]   ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630348 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [133, 15, 191, 46]   ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630346 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [11, 106, 69, 87]    ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630348 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [223, 97, 230, 230]  ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630348 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [128, 6, 26, 58]     ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630348 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [209, 231, 66, 54]   ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630348 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [153, 239, 95, 184]  ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630347 conf=false cw_gt=true
  [178, 236, 242, 44]  ever_ibd=false cooldown=ok tip_h=630347 conf=false cw_gt=true
```

Reading directly: 8 connected peers, every one reporting a current-mainnet tip with `cw_gt=true` (chain verifiably more work), every one `conf=false` (background tip validation kept deadline-exceeding), every one `ever_ibd=false`. The wedge root cause was visible from one log block; previous wedges of similar shape (the #11 stuck-IBD timeline) required source-walking to triage. This is the change that will make the next wedge cheap to land at, regardless of which AND clause is failing.

## What doesn't change

* No selection-logic change — `should_ibd` eligibility criteria and cooldown semantics are identical. This commit is purely observability.
